decision: Scan-only Temerario-style reel for the GR86 (gen 2); reuse ferrari-296 tools/shot.py, composite.py, logo_card.py and huracan-evo regcheck/hinge ideas
why: Brief: siblings pushed a keyframed shot renderer and composite tools that already implement the house look; reusing them keeps the batch consistent

decision: Hero car = 'BRZ Full Car' (18vYkgpx...), not 'GR86 Full Car'
why: Every Bomex part/state scan registers to the BRZ Full Car raw frame (overlap 49-92 %, median 2.6-5 mm) and has 0 % overlap with GR86 Full Car (different frame); render shows the BRZ horizontal-slat grille. Project dir stays toyota-gr86 per brief

decision: Levelled with tools/level2.py (PCA axes, nose from the Front Bumper Only scan -> -Y, tyre-contact plane -> z=0); one rigid transform for every scan
why: No ground in the BRZ scan: RANSAC ground fit locked onto a door panel and laid the car on its side; tyre contacts are the true ground

decision: Panels: front/rear bumper = Bomex part scans with pinned ICP (xf/*_icp.npy, <=16 mm move); hood = car tris missing from 'Hood Open' + filled top-view mask (tools/hood_mask.py); mirrors = car tris outboard of 'Side Mirrors Removed'
why: Bumper part scans are loose captures (ICP 0.4/1.2 deg); no hood part scan exists and the open hood was not captured, so the car's own hood is the panel; difference-only extraction left holes and fragments

decision: No trunk-open shot; trunk lid not in the exploded set
why: Trunk Open / Trunk Open Bumper Off scans do not capture a usable lid (looked at state renders); extraction was patchy

decision: Exploded set: hood (lifts highest), front bumper, rear bumper; mirrors stay on the car
why: Left mirror in the full-car scan is a thin dark stick (poor capture) - flying it out would show a broken part; right one alone would look lopsided

decision: Explode base fills: Hood Open (engine bay), Bumper Hood Removed below z 650 mm, Rear Bumper Removed, Trunk Open Bumper Off below 750 mm
why: Unlimited fills added half-open hood remnants and the raised trunk lid as floating sheets at the cowl/deck (seen in expl check render)

decision: Shot list: s1 front-right 3/4 low turntable, s2 rear-right 3/4 orbit, s3 headlight/intake close-up (2 mm crop), s4 tail lamp + ducktail close-up (2 mm crop), s5 hood opens 52 deg on its cowl hinge, s6 near top-down with the car turning, s7 explode (hood, front + rear bumper lift into layers above the car and return), logo card
why: Temerario order from the brief; right side because the left mirror is a broken capture; headlight instead of wheel because tyres/spokes are incomplete in the scan (framing checks)

decision: Music: toyota-gr86_track.mp3 (lo-fi drift funk generated for this car by the parent session); kick-anchored analysis (tools/accents.py): bar downbeats every 2.449 s (98.0 BPM) from 0.064 s, double-kick phrase starts every 2 bars (9.87, 14.76, 19.66, 24.56, 29.46, 34.35), loud return at 34.35, audible to 39.24 s
why: Lessons: anchor cuts on kick peaks, not the generic onset grid; measure where generated tracks end
2-bar holds for the turntables/hood/top-down, 1-bar holds for the two close-ups (varied holds per lessons), a long explode over the quiet middle section into the loud return

decision: Hood lifts beat 1 -> next downbeat (15.37 -> 17.21 s); explode separates on 27.003, drifts through the sparse section, slams home on the 34.350 loud return, settles 2.45 s, logo 36.80 -> 39.25
why: Mechanical moves land on the strongest hits; the return section is where the reassembly should hit

decision: Renders via tools/shot.py (ferrari-296 shot.py + skip finished frames)
why: The container restarted mid-render and killed Blender; resume avoids re-rendering ~11 s frames

decision: Lights set invisible to camera in shot.py; s7 frames 88-186 re-rendered
why: the explode camera's high orbit passed behind the big key area light from frame 88, turning the rest of the shot into black silhouettes

decision: Persistent data off in shot.py; luma-checked s1-s6 (no steps); s7 resumed from frame 100
why: lessons.md user rule (2026-11-11): Cycles persistent data drops the studio lights mid-animation; s7 frame 88+ was exactly that (frame time halved, luma 31->6), not light occlusion as first assumed

decision: Scene director + director agents run before final cut
why: lessons.md/workflow.md user rule: shot order comes from the car's scan features, set by the scene-director agent

decision: v2 order from direction.md/director.md: A whole-car opener -> s3 headlight -> C front section (hood off, bay, front bumper off + structure) -> D rear section (bumper off, crash beam) -> E top stack -> s7 reassembly tail -> fade -> small logo
why: user rules relayed 2026-11-11 (lessons.md): order by this car's scan features, travel front->rear, one section per sequence, bumper-removed data as hero beat, no redundant orbits/top-down spins, whole car in the opener

decision: Dropped s1, s2, s4, s5, s6 and s7 frames 1-110
why: s1 tail cropped, s2 redundant orbit with a broken tyre, s4 black hole in the left lamp, s5 swung the closed hood skin (open hood never scanned = faked opening), s6 top-down spin showed nothing new, s7 opened all parts at once in one wide orbit

decision: Hood lifts off (translate up) instead of hinging; bumpers tip 110 deg to show their scanned inner faces, then slide out of frame
why: rule: never fake an opening, spin only parts whose backside is scanned; stills showed the parked parts clipping the frame edge during the structure push-ins

decision: Labels: FRONT BUMPER REMOVED / HOOD REMOVED (15.06-16.95), REAR BUMPER REMOVED (19.96-21.85), REAR CRASH BEAM (22.41-24.30); small 330 px logo card after a 0.5 s fade
why: user: bumper-removed data highlighted, labeled and shown in detail; Temerario ending (fade, small logo). Wording from the Drive state-scan names and the visible holed beam in the Rear Bumper Removed scan; no numbers

decision: d_front rendered 150f; luma 35.9-103.7, no steps; sheet checked: hood exits top, bumper tips out bottom-left, structure push-in ends filling frame
why: lessons.md: luma-check every shot and look at first/mid/last before assembly

decision: Flattened the licence plate in car4 and rear_bumper (tools/deplate.py); comp_explode left as scanned
why: lessons.md: scans carry a legible plate; g_rear f1 and s_stack f113 read '9MEN074' at full res. comp_explode's base is the rear-bumper-removed state, where the plate box only holds the crash beam, which must stay real data

decision: g_rear late camera targets raised (z 0.50->0.60/0.72/0.70)
why: late frames clipped the trunk lid at the top with 40% dead black below; now the beam sits mid-frame and the REAR CRASH BEAM label sits on black

decision: Re-render g_rear + s_stack in full
why: both show the rear bumper's plate; the s7 tail (110-186) only views the front-left, so no plate there

decision: a_open camera: ~20 deg arc (4.60,-4.70)->(2.10,-5.90) with a push, replacing the 0.8 m dolly
why: ive director: 4.8 s of dead frames - the v1 dolly read as static; the opener rule wants motion from frame 1

decision: f_reassemble fade starts 0.45 s after the parts land (st 2.9, d 2.0) instead of a 2 s hold + 0.5 s fade
why: ive director flagged a 2.4 s dead hold; lessons: the ending must not hold too long - fade, then the small logo

decision: section/focus tags on every clip
why: ive director needs them to check that each section plays as one continuous sequence and every shot has a subject
